title: Relief faces (rough earth/rock), fbm noise, backing volume
summary: Displaced-plane relief faces for cut earth, rock and spoil (critic-tuned noise scales, clamped pits), a face registry to seat props on the surface, a closed backing volume, lumpy boxes and lips.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: import { relief, reliefFaces, backing, lumpyLip } from '../library/module.any.relief/index.js';

doc.when: Cut-away earth, rock walls, tunnel ceilings/floors, spoil heaps: anything that must read rough at render scale. Pair every relief that bodies could touch with backing() so S.collide treats the earth as solid.
doc.avoid: Amplitude judged in a close-up: too little reads as a texture, too much as foam/sponge. Backing boxes at the clamped-plateau depth (z-fight).
gotchas: UVs are metric (1 UV = 1 m) by default: use materials with repeat = 1 / tile (perMetre).
Edges are pinned to 0 over 12 cm so faces meet their neighbours; pass pin: false for free edges.
Deep pits are clamped at -.12 amp: that makes flat plateaus; keep backing volumes >= .3 m behind the face (backing() does).
A relief is open: never list it as an S.collide solid; list its backing().
reliefFaces().surf ignores faces marked { back: true }.

params.relief(w, h, amp, seed, mat, o): o.res (28 verts/m), o.tile (1), o.pin, o.bias, o.freq
